title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Foundry Specimen. Host Console is discarded. Facts, routes, and the user manual stay. The character-goods catalog was dropped from the hand: invented mascots and a popularity grid cannot carry Preview without fabricating proof.

options.label: Foundry Specimen
options.thesis: The site is a specimen of the OS as a type system: the thesis is the display cut, grants are shown styles, install is how you set the face.
options.viewport: A full paper sheet: wordmark as the specimen word at display size, honesty as the colophon under it, Install as the only inked rule at the foot.
options.risk: Can read as a design-studio site if the specimen word is prettier than the Preview limits.

raised.raise: Riso grain: ink sits on toothy paper. The sheet is a material, not a flat digital beige.
Chord rest: a bright open field. The paper must breathe; no filled dark void.
Dated batch: Preview 0.1.2 is a stamped date on every page, not a hidden footer.

options.label: Release Gazette
options.lineage: GitHub Releases notes as a printed gazette
options.thesis: The landing is today’s Release: version, assets, checksums of honesty, then the download.
options.viewport: Masthead PREVIEW 0.1.2, assets as a ruled list (zip, tar.gz, scripts), honesty as the lead paragraph, Download as the marked asset.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on: the site as release notes.

options.label: Grant Network
options.thesis: Capabilities are lines on a porcelain map; install is the interchange; first-run is the destination.
options.viewport: A midnight field with four named lines (session, gpu, net, audit) meeting at one interchange labeled install.
options.case: Holds audience identification: testers already read maps. Loses on product clarity: a metro can hide that this is a host app with tokens.
options.risk: Reads as a metaphor poster if the lines are prettier than the NVIDIA limit.

options.label: Segment Mask
options.thesis: Preview status is a rigid LED mask: version lit, missing GPU as the flashing 12:00, grants as cells on or ghosted.
options.viewport: Four large cells read 0.1.2; a status row under them: HOST / NVIDIA / NOT BOOTABLE; Install is a held-button label.
options.case: Holds product clarity for honesty and version. Loses on audience identification: a clock face is not where testers decide to download.
options.risk: Docs cannot live in eight-cell glyphs; inner pages must keep the mask as chrome, not as the only voice.

options.label: Riso Host
options.thesis: The host is warm paper; grant, deny, and live are two or three fluorescent inks that misregister on hover.
options.viewport: A paper sheet with the thesis in one spot ink and Install in another, slightly off register.
options.case: Loses both axes: testers do not identify with print-shop culture, and spot inks do not explain a host app.
options.kept: Ink as material on paper, not a flat fill.
options.risk: Reads as a poster club, not an install.

options.label: Color Chord
options.thesis: Overlapping grants as translucent color chords over a sun-white rest.
options.viewport: A bright open field with three crossing banners named session, gpu, net.
options.case: Loses both axes: courtyard silk is not this cohort’s world, and chords hide the NVIDIA limit.
options.kept: A bright open rest instead of a filled dark page.

options.label: Batch Calendar
options.thesis: Preview is an immature batch: dated jars for install, first-run, and feedback.
options.viewport: A shelf of dated jars; the current batch is 0.1.2.
options.case: Loses both axes: fermentation is not how testers think about a host app.
options.kept: The version as a stamped batch on every page.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark AI-OS hero, three feature cards, a Download button, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: A night hero, a metric or feature row, a primary download.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from neighboring agent desktops by design.
